newsitem.title: GERMANY: BASF to close recycling test plant.
newsitem.headline: BASF to close recycling test plant.

text.p: German chemicals group BASF AG said on Tuesday it had closed down a test plant designed to investigate whether certain raw materials could be recycled from plastics.
The group said that operations have been refined and that there was no longer any need for a test facility. Also capacity usage was no longer high enough to warrant full time operations, BASF said.
BASF said it would however license the "know-how" behind the plant, adding that talks were underway with Veba Oel to see whether the BASF technology could optimise their operations.
